text: Yes, the sources agree on the tree-cover loss in 2012. Hansen GFC reports a tree-cover loss of 1.4 ha in 2012, which is corroborated by JRC GFC2020, showing that 51% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020. The MGAP forest map 2021 indicates that the event area was not native forest, but rather planted forest (0.4 ha) and an equal amount outside mapped forest. This agreement among sources confirms the tree-cover loss event in 2012.
